review.mathCheck: The set {11,...,20} attains size 10. For maximum \(m=2r\), complementary pairs and exclusion of r give \(|S|\le r\le10\). review.annotationCheck: The construction and universal upper bound directly assess the extremal concept. The pair-capacity argument is a valid pigeonhole application even without naming the principle. No material case or explanatory gap.
